largerModelExperiment.reason: Higher coverage but worse p95 start/end errors; no automatic model replacement.

karaoke.shortSegmentsExperiment: Two overlapping 15s windows did not reliably repair the two Wordsmith cases; not installed.
karaoke.implemented: Exact adjacent ASR tokens may represent one written contraction, with measured first/last boundaries and the same uniqueness, duration and occurrence protections. No timestamps invented for missing words.

limitations: Current same-profile complete pairs remain 15; the 18 additional complete pairs do not improve this fixed-profile listening simulation.
No certified semantic chorus/solo/build annotations or human listening quality score. Model hypotheses remain hypotheses.
No physical iPhone/PWA/background endurance claim. Offline manifests and queues in simulations are explicit synthetic scenarios.
The 590-word corpus is English, with manual references, and is not a held-out Italian accuracy benchmark.
